claims.quote: 'the most picturesque brewery' — on a bicentennial family farm; hops, wheat and barley grown on the property; farm-field patio; taproom in the bottom of the historic Old Barn
claims.note: Corey's 'go experience this really fun brewery, it's on a field' archetype. Estate brewing (own-grown ingredients) is a differentiator almost no Ontario brewery has.

claims.quote: live music weekly Sat 4–7, Sun 1–4; outdoor stage and play area; hosts weddings in the barn hall; farm + hop-field tours in summer
Crosscut Canadian Ale — 'a resurrection of a traditional Canadian recipe'; 100% Ontario-grown hops; 'all great tasting beers', samples 'quite generous'
claims.source: Beer Et Seq + Beaumont Drinks + Brewers Journal Canada + TripAdvisor
claims.note: Beer voice is solid-traditional, not elite-hype. Styles: Canadian ale, English IPA, amber lager, weissbier, American stout. No hazy program — a hazy query should NOT route here; a 'great farm brewery day out' query absolutely should.
